questions.stem: The Santosh Trophy is a prestigious inter-state national championship contested in India for which sport?

options.option_text: Association football (national inter-state championship)
Field hockey (inter-zonal national tournament, India)
Kabaddi (national men's state-level championship, India)
Basketball (national inter-state league tournament, India)

questions.explanation: The Santosh Trophy is the national football championship of India, competed among state associations under the All India Football Federation (AIFF). It was donated by Sir Santosh in 1941. Hockey is a common wrong pick because of famous hockey trophies like Rangaswamy Cup, but that is unrelated to Santosh Trophy.

questions.stem: The Irani Cup in Indian domestic cricket is contested between which two sides?

options.option_text: Rest of India versus the reigning Ranji Trophy champion
India A versus India B in a four-day domestic trial match
North Zone versus South Zone in a zonal selection duel
Defending Duleep Trophy winner versus the current Ranji champion

questions.explanation: The Irani Cup is played between Rest of India (a selected team) and the Ranji Trophy defending champion. It was donated by the Irani family in memory of Z.R. Irani, a former BCCI official. Option D is a common confusion — the Duleep Trophy involves zonal teams, not the Irani Cup.

questions.stem: The Duleep Trophy in Indian domestic cricket is named after K.S. Duleepsinhji. He is best remembered for which of the following?

options.option_text: Playing Test cricket for England despite being born in Indian royalty
Being the first Indian-origin player to score a Test double century
Captaining India in the first-ever official Test series of 1932
Being the elder brother of K.S. Ranjitsinhji, the Sussex captain

questions.explanation: K.S. Duleepsinhji was born in the Nawanagar princely state but chose to represent England in Test cricket, scoring 995 Test runs. He was the NEPHEW (not elder brother) of Ranjitsinhji — a common distractor. He never captained or played for India; the trophy honours his Indian origins while acknowledging his England career.

questions.stem: The Rangaswamy Cup is contested among zonal teams in India. In which sport is this cup awarded?

options.option_text: Field hockey (inter-zonal national cup, Hockey India)
Cricket (restricted-overs inter-zonal tournament, BCCI)
Football (state-team competition organised by the AIFF)
Kabaddi (national inter-zone cup, Amateur Kabaddi Federation)

questions.explanation: The Rangaswamy Cup is a hockey tournament contested among the five Indian Hockey zones (North, South, East, West, Central). It was donated by M.A.M. Ramaswamy. Cricket candidates often confuse it with BCCI zonal cups like Duleep or Deodhar Trophies, but those have entirely different names.

questions.stem: The Swaythling Cup and the Corbillon Cup are both awarded at the World Table Tennis Championships. Which statement correctly distinguishes the two?

options.option_text: Swaythling is for men's team event; Corbillon is for women's team
Swaythling is for singles events; Corbillon is for team championships
Swaythling is for Asia-Pacific teams; Corbillon is for European zones
Swaythling is for senior teams; Corbillon is for junior team events

questions.explanation: The Swaythling Cup (donated by Lady Swaythling in 1926) is the men's team trophy at the World Table Tennis Championships, while the Corbillon Cup (donated by Marcel Corbillon in 1934) is the women's equivalent. Options B, C, and D are fabrications — neither trophy distinguishes by singles vs teams, region, or age group.

questions.stem: The Duleep Trophy made cricket history in the 2016–17 season by introducing pink-ball day-night cricket in India for the first time domestically. Which format was adopted for this landmark series?

options.option_text: Day-night four-day matches contested among India's five zonal teams
Day-night T20 knockout rounds among top four Ranji Trophy state teams
Pink-ball 50-over final between the North Zone and South Zone teams
Five-day Test-format matches between India A and India B squads

questions.explanation: In 2016–17, BCCI used the Duleep Trophy as a pink-ball pilot — four-day first-class matches played under lights among India's five zones (North, South, East, West, Central). Option D (India A vs India B) is the format used when BCCI later reorganised the Duleep Trophy, not in the 2016-17 pink-ball edition, making it a strong distractor.

questions.stem: The Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy, awarded annually since 1956–57, specifically recognises excellence in which of the following?

options.option_text: The university with the best overall performance at inter-university sports
The state team with the highest medal tally at the National Games
The individual athlete with the most gold medals in a single calendar year
The top-ranked SAI (Sports Authority of India) regional training centre

questions.explanation: The MAKA Trophy is awarded by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to the university that performs best overall across All India Inter-University Sports and Games Championships — it ranks aggregate sporting output of universities, not state teams or individuals. Options B and C are common confusions with National Games and Arjuna Award criteria respectively.
